clues: This city lies east of Los Angeles, in the west of its county. It is part of the great Los Angeles city lands in California.
Hot summers and mild winters rule this dry land. Strong Santa Ana winds sweep in often in autumn and winter, and folk know them well.
This town was set up in 1882 by an engineer and his two brothers. They came from Canada to build a model town here.
Planes haul more freight through here than through most air fields in the land. Its airport ranks eighth in the whole United States for cargo.
Freight from two great sea ports passes through this town. From here, goods fan out to the rest of the whole land.
